note: Subset of the brand-svg collection (branches feat/brand-svg-gallery and feat/brand-svg-jp, schema v3) used by the landing: hero keycaps (data/hero-caps.json) and the DESIGN.md-to-screen picker chips. Only the variants the landing shows are kept; every provenance field (source, source_url, license, license_url, usage_note, attribution, dark_bg) is copied unchanged. Files: web/public/brand-svg/<id>/<variant>.svg. Logos are trademarks of their owners; shown for reference. Adding a record here (with its file) turns that company's glyph cap or chip into a logo one with no code change. A risk_tier "high" record never goes on a keycap; it reaches the picker chip only when it also carries "landing_use": "flat-chip" (the logo as delivered, flat, on a plain tile with clear space — LINE's guideline forbids decoration, shadow, 3D and modification). landing_use is the only field added on import.
